papers.title: Fatigue behavior of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V in tubular geometry: influence of internal surface texture and build orientation
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Auburn University, Auburn, AL 36849, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Nima Shamsaei
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Auburn University, Auburn, AL 36849, USA

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究增材制造Ti-6Al-4V管状几何的疲劳行为，涵盖内部表面纹理和构建方向的影响，完全符合本方向对力学和疲劳性能的要求。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not include computational modeling or simulation, but experimental validation is sufficient; it lacks post-processing comparison but is focused on as-built state.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究内部表面纹理和构建方向对增材制造Ti-6Al-4V管状试样疲劳行为的影响。
summary_zh.method: 对不同内部表面状态和构建方向的增材制造Ti-6Al-4V管进行疲劳测试。
summary_zh.result: 内部表面纹理和构建方向显著影响疲劳寿命。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验疲劳测试验证结果。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of internal surface texture and build orientation on the fatigue behavior of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V tubular specimens.
summary_en.method: Fatigue testing was conducted on additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V tubes with varying internal surface finishes and build orientations.
summary_en.result: Internal surface texture and build orientation significantly affect the fatigue life of the additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V tubular components.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through experimental fatigue tests on actual additively manufactured specimens.
